description: Use this when the user asks about one public Redstone portfolio, usually a search_portfolios result: its holdings with each one's own figures, its returns over YTD, 1 year and 5 years, max drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, beta and dividend yield, charted against SPY. Not for a portfolio the user describes (use backtest_portfolio) or private portfolios.
